notes.subject: החקקים/חקקי
notes.rationale: Root חקק repeated — 'those who engrave engraved-things' — the engraving of decrees echoes in both noun and verb, flattened in Sepedi.

notes.subject: עמל
notes.rationale: 'Toil/oppression': KJV 'grievousness', JPS 'iniquity'; rendered here as go hloriša (oppression) after the object of the decrees in v.2.

notes.subject: ba ralago melawana
notes.rationale: Prophetic woe (הוי) addressed directly to the lawmakers of Yehuda.

translation: Ao ba ralago melawana ya bobe, le ba ngwalago go hloriša — ba e ngwadile.
